evidence_locator: sycophancy / FlipFlop section — challenging a model's answer, including a correct one, makes it capitulate and revise toward the perceived expectation rather than toward truth
headline thesis — a problem appearing a second time indicts the management system rather than the individual item or the team
organizational-learning-failure section — without a mechanism forcing a reference to past root causes, every recurrence becomes a fresh investigation even where the answer already exists
convergence-failure section — a reflection loop thrashes for four or more rounds without converging when the lesson buffer does not constrain the next attempt
rise-and-collapse failure mode — a self-improvement loop degrades the artefact it is improving past an inflection point

vocabulary model — a prose linter separates the term list (accepted / rejected spellings) from the style rules, and its false-positive control is syntax awareness: code fences, inline code and frontmatter are skipped rather than matched

longitudinal measurement over ~211M changed lines, 2020-2024 — copy/pasted code rose from 8.3 percent to 12.3 percent of changes over the period AI assistance became common, i.e. generated code trends toward duplication rather than reuse

rule documentation — a switch-exhaustiveness check over a union or enum reports a missing member only while no default clause is present; a default suppresses the report, so the fallback branch hides exactly the incomplete-refactor case the check exists to catch. The check is type-aware and therefore carries a build-time cost.
ubiquitous-language principle — a concept carries one term across the whole model, and several terms for one concept is itself a modelling defect rather than a style preference
